Eliminates premature 30-minute timeout kills on active long-running turns, adds the `libccrun.so` native trampoline for multi-hop Go execution under targetSdk 36, and fixes new-session model pin persistence, ghost background tasks, context-bar jumping, and toolchain swap errors.

## What's New

- **Sliding inactivity watchdog for long ACP turns**: Upgraded `session/prompt`'s default 30-minute hard timer in `acp.mjs` to a zero-overhead sliding inactivity watchdog that extends on incoming JSON-RPC stream updates and pending permission prompts (while keeping genuine stalls bounded and capped), stopping active >30-minute tasks from being killed at 1,800s and triggering `Server restart`, with gateway error logging added.
- **Immediate new-session visibility, model `pin` persistence & scoped usage**: Persists the initial user turn before `session/prompt` so new sessions appear immediately in the sidebar; `noteAcpInit` now saves per-session model and thought-level `pin` settings on first init so subsequent turns never fall back to global defaults; background session usage updates are scoped so the top context bar no longer jumps across concurrent sessions.
- **Accurate ACP background task tracking & stop persistence**: `run_command` side-effect detection now inspects only the tool envelope header (preventing completed `rg`/`cat` outputs containing keywords from spawning ghost background tasks), preserves `/` in task IDs, clears stale shell entries on empty `manage_task(list)`, and prevents stopped tasks from resurrecting at turn end.
- **targetSdk 36 native trampoline (`libccrun.so`) & installer hardening**: Added `libccrun.so` and `loader-bin` symlinks so `agy` and nested Go tools (`gh → git`) executing raw `SYS_execve` syscalls work seamlessly under targetSdk 36 W^X; fixed read-only directory cleanup during toolchain swap ("rename failed"), forwarded `promptCacheTtl`, and made `GatewaySquattedTest` compatible with Android 10+ SELinux `/proc/net/tcp` restrictions.

Eliminates recurring `Server restart` kills during active subagents, clears all remaining `v0.1.6` frontend `ReferenceError` crashes (Settings & Lineage), and fixes Android watchdog uptime heartbeats, OAuth login `xdg-open` stalls, and `cli-bridge` hangs.

## What's New

- **Stop `ACP_POOL` idle GC from killing active subagents (`Server restart`)**: Added `classifyAcpTool()` in `acp.mjs` to strip `"Run "` prefixes and fall back to input-schema detection for real `agy acp` tools (`invoke_subagent`, `send_message`, `manage_subagents`, `run_command`, `schedule`); preserved empty or JSON (`conversationId`/`logAbsoluteUri`) launch results in `bgTasks`; added `acpChildActive()` probing `/proc/<pid>/stat` CPU ticks and recent `acp-server-*-<pid>.log` writes before sending `SIGTERM`; prevented partial idle wakes from wiping sibling running subagents, raised default idle TTL to 30 minutes, and prioritized evicting sessions without background tasks.
- **Fix Settings `ReferenceError` & Lineage page crash**: Restored missing `v0.1.6` visibility/visit helpers and state bindings (`cat`, `viewRead`, `sameGet`, `updRev`, etc.) across Settings/Device/Model/Boot segments, and restored `ensureLinMap()` and `linPause()` in `18b-lineage.js` / `14-projects-sched.js` to stop Lineage page crashes and timer leaks.
- **Fix dead Android install watchdog heartbeat (Upstream PR #265)**: On Android, `/proc/uptime` returns `EACCES`, previously falling back to wall-clock `Date.now()` which `GatewayService.parseBeatAt()` rejected as future timestamps; `uptimeMs()` and `usage.mjs` now fall back to `Math.floor(os.uptime()) * 1000` (`CLOCK_BOOTTIME`).
- **Fix OAuth login `xdg-open` popup stall & harden `cli-bridge` (Upstream PR #265)**: `loginBrowserEnv()` strips `app/pre` from `PATH` and prepends lightweight `xdg-open`/`termux-open-url` shims pointing to `browser.sh` so Google OAuth login never stalls on a redundant native confirmation dialog; `cli-bridge.mjs` adds a 70s socket timeout, 10s stdin timeout, 200k-char cap, and `--` separator handling; `Priv.java` / `MainActivity.java` now attribute `CCAPP_RUN=1` audits to `agy` / `Antigravity`.

Hotfix for the critical `v0.1.6` startup regression locking the UI on "Waiting for gateway…", plus a fix for the Extensions GitHub CLI (`gh`) login card getting stuck on "Requesting a one-time code from GitHub…".

## What's New

- **Fix background-thread `CookieManager.setCookie` crash locking startup**: `MainActivity.writeGatewayCookie()` now dispatches 3-argument `CookieManager.setCookie(..., callback)` onto a dedicated main-Looper `Handler` and awaits in-memory CookieStore completion via a bounded `CountDownLatch` (300ms), avoiding Chromium's `IllegalStateException` on Looper-less `ui-prove` / WebView IO threads while keeping `flush()` asynchronous and unaffected by `onDestroy`.
- **Isolate `Env.onBoot` callback failures**: `Env.proveBootOnce()` now calls `onBoot` through `Env.invokeOnBoot()` with an isolated `try/catch (Throwable)` and error logging so a Cookie callback failure can never invalidate an already-verified gateway proof or trigger a 61ms reload-quota exhaustion loop against the 3-second `provedAt` cache.
- **Add diagnostics to `Env.fetchStatic()`**: Log sanitized warnings on non-200 HTTP statuses and exceptions instead of silently returning `null`.
- **Fix Extensions GitHub CLI (`gh`) one-time code never appearing**: `ghLoginEnv()` strips `app/pre` from `PATH` so `gh auth login --web` does not invoke `termux-clipboard-set` and block on a surprise clipboard confirmation dialog, and `parseGhDeviceOutput()` now matches both `First copy your one-time code: XXXX-XXXX` and the clipboard-succeeded `One-time code (XXXX-XXXX) copied to clipboard` format (with ANSI stripping).

## What's New

- **Android Host Stability & Anti-Restart Fixes (Upstream PR #254 / #255)**: Added epoch-scoped single-flight `ProofFlight` and 3.5s read timeout in `Env.proveGateway()` so concurrent `/api/*` traffic and component downloads no longer collide into 502s; upgraded `GatewayService` to ref-counted `PAUSE_LOCK`, `pauseKick()`, and asynchronous shutdown so rapid restarts never drop the supervisor thread or trigger false watchdog kills; added `uiLoadGen` sequencing in `MainActivity` with immediate in-memory CookieStore sync and deferred 250ms SQLite flush; hardened thread safety across `Consent`, `ShizukuSetup`, `Updater`, `Share`, and `DeviceTools`.

- **Security Hardening & 9-Language Parity**: Hardened `Share.java` against case-insensitive FUSE credential bypasses (e.g. `.SSH/ID_RSA`) and `/data/data/` bind-mount aliases; added `realpath` symlink secret filtering in `archiver.mjs`; aligned all 9 Web languages (3172/3172) and Android Java dictionaries (567/567).

Major cold-start frontend readiness speedup: eliminates the startup `agy` subprocess storm that saturated WebView's connection pool, staggers gateway maintenance sweeps, and removes blocking CookieManager disk flushes.

## What's New

- **Cold-Start SWR Disk Cache & Shared `agy models` Single-Flight**: Unified `agy models` execution across `models.mjs` and `login.mjs` with in-flight coalescing and disk caching (`~/.cache/hachimia-agy-models.json`, `~/.cache/hachimia-auth.json`); cold boot returns cached models and login status in milliseconds when local credentials exist and verifies silently after 1.5s, while deferring background `/usage` + `/credits` probes by 4s during the first 8s after gateway boot.
- **Non-Blocking Frontend Boot & Connection-Pool Relief**: Coalesced concurrent read-only `GET /api/login/status` and `GET /api/models` requests inside `api()` so WebView's 6-socket per-origin HTTP/1.1 pool is no longer starved while loading chat history; restored the `setOpen` guard on `renderProvCard()`; made `loadModels()` non-blocking inside `loadSettings()` so `boot()` completes immediately; deferred non-essential settings pre-fetches to 6s and dropped duplicate calls.
- **Staggered Gateway Startup Maintenance**: Split `server.mjs`'s synchronous 150ms post-listen sweep (which collided directly with WebView's initial request wave) into staggered 1500–2400ms idle slices.
- **Native Cookie Deduplication & Deferred Flush**: Deduplicated redundant `applyGatewayCookie` writes in `MainActivity` and moved `CookieManager.flush()` to a 250ms deferred call after `web.loadUrl()` begins once Chromium's in-memory CookieStore confirms the cookie.

- **Default AGY Monet Dynamic Theme**: Defaults to Material You `shise` (`ss-auto`) with an AGY aurora blue (`#4285f4`) fallback across WebView, native splash, and in-app browser.
- **Self-Update & Release Pipeline**: Migrated APK signature verification, GitHub Releases, notices, and `agy` version checks to `greyoak111/hachimia`.
